content: 1. Anthony Harries is affiliated with the International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease, serving as a co-chair. He is based in the European Region, specifically in the United Kingdom. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 2. Fabio Caldas de Mesquita works with the Ministry of Health in Brazil, specifically in the STI, AIDS, and Viral Hepatitis Department, also serving as a co-chair. He operates within the Region of the Americas and has declared no conflicts of interest. 3. Tsitsi Apollo is associated with the Ministry of Health and Child Care in Zimbabwe, representing the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 4. Helen Ayles is affiliated with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and ZAMBART, based in the European Region, United Kingdom. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 5. Ferenc Bagyinszky is part of the European AIDS Treatment Group, located in Germany within the European Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 6. Joe Barker works for the Office of the Global AIDS Coordinator and Health Diplomacy under the United States Department of State. He is an employee of the United States Government, specifically the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), seconded to OGAC since 2013. His salary is funded by PEPFAR, and all official travel is covered by PEPFAR. He has been requested to make statements on equity, epidemiology, monitoring, evaluation, and surveillance on behalf of PEPFAR. He has declared no significant financial conflicts of interest. 7. David Barr is affiliated with the Fremont Center in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 8. John Blandford is associated with the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, operating in the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 9. Thomas Cai is part of AIDS Care China, located in the Western Pacific Region, China. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 10. Karen Cohen is affiliated with the University of Cape Town in South Africa, representing the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 11. John Crowley works for the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) in the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 12. François Dabis is associated with Université de Bordeaux in France, within the European Region. He is the principal investigator of a large treatment trial and has declared non-financial significant interests. He is partially excluded from decision-making or voting on relevant PICO questions. 13. Carol El-Hayek is part of the Burnet Institute in Australia, located in the Western Pacific Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 14. Carlos Falistocco is the President of GCTH in Argentina, within the Region of the Americas. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 15. Ruby Fayorsey is affiliated with ICAP at Columbia University in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 16. Robert Ferris is a full-time direct-hire employee of the United States Government, working for USAID on global HIV issues. His travel costs are fully covered by the United States Government/USAID. He has declared no significant financial conflicts of interest. 17. Elvin Geng is associated with the University of California, San Francisco, in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He is the principal investigator of a large treatment trial and has declared non-financial significant interests. He is partially excluded from decision-making or voting on relevant PICO questions. 18. Lucy Ghati is part of the National Empowerment Network of People Living with HIV/AIDS in Kenya, representing the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 19. Diana Gibb is affiliated with the MRC Clinical Trials Unit at University College London in the United Kingdom, within the European Region. She has received funding support from ViiV Healthcare for the ARROW virology sub-study and other trials. She has declared financial significant interests and is partially excluded from decision-making or voting on relevant PICO questions. 20. Eric Goemaere is part of Médecins Sans Frontières in South Africa, representing the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 21. Christopher Hoffman is affiliated with Johns Hopkins University in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He received a dinner and train ticket for an advisory board meeting with Gilead, valued at less than $400. He has declared non-significant financial interests. 22. Ilesh Jani is associated with Instituto Nacional de Saúde in Mozambique, within the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 23. Medhi Karkouri is part of CHU Ibn Rochd/Faculté de Médecine de Casablanca in Morocco, representing the Eastern Mediterranean Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 24. Bekezela Bebbie Khabom is affiliated with the Ministry of Health in Zimbabwe, within the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 25. Siti Nadia is part of the National AIDS Program under the Ministry of Health in Indonesia, representing the South-East Asia Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 26. Jean Nachega is affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh in the United States, within the Region of the Americas. He has received significant financial support from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the Wellcome Trust for research at Stellenbosch University. He is partially excluded from decision-making or voting on relevant PICO questions. 27. Hai Nguyen Huu is part of the Vietnam Authority of HIV/AIDS Control, representing the South-East Asia Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 28. Sabin Nsanzimana is affiliated with the Rwanda Biomedical Center, representing the African Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 29. Daniella Mark is part of PATA in South Africa, within the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 30. Gitau Mburu is a senior adviser for HIV and health systems at the International HIV/AIDS Alliance in the United Kingdom, within the European Region. He provides expertise in community-based testing, prevention, treatment, and care, as well as advocacy and support for country policies related to HIV. He has declared non-financial, non-significant interests. 31. Irene Mukui is affiliated with the Ministry of Health, National AIDS and STI Control Program in Kenya, representing the African Region. She has declared no conflicts of interest. 32. Bora Ngauv is part of the Ministry of Health in Cambodia, within the Western Pacific Region. He has declared no conflicts of interest. 33. Nataliya Nizova is associated with the Ukrainian Center for Socially Dangerous Disease Control. Further details are not provided in the excerpt.
